question: Should OpenClaw accept this restart-specific durable audit table with the current metadata fields, redaction rules, 512-row retention cap, and restart-path write placement?
rationale: The remaining choice is not only code correctness: this PR creates a durable local record for operational metadata and writes it near restart control flow, which needs maintainer/security intent before becoming the product boundary.

options.title: Accept Current Audit Boundary
options.body: After the Windows failed-emission audit gap is fixed and the branch is refreshed, merge the bounded SQLite restart audit as the intended operator-forensics surface.

options.title: Narrow Persisted Metadata
options.body: Require fewer stored fields or stricter redaction before merge if actor, device, IP, changed-path, or preflight metadata is too broad for local audit storage.

options.title: Defer To Broader Audit Ledger
options.body: Pause or close this PR if restart audit records should wait for a single canonical audit-ledger design instead of adding a restart-specific producer now.

recommendation.title: Accept Current Audit Boundary
recommendation.body: After the Windows failed-emission audit gap is fixed and the branch is refreshed, merge the bounded SQLite restart audit as the intended operator-forensics surface.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter's history owns much of the gateway restart/reload behavior and this choice is a product/security boundary for that surface.
